title: Your home base for Crete
text: The places we send our guests to, with honest drive times from the hotel. Out to the gorges by day, home by golden hour.
bay_text: The village beach is 1.2 km away, about 15 minutes on foot: a sandy bay with tavernas along the water and a small island off the shore. Kalyves, the next village, is 6 km along the coast.
bay_short: A sandy bay with tavernas along the water and a small island off the shore.
